before: Every closed field is one offset unit in the store.
after: The store keeps every field one unit by default. A new editable mode addresses saved field results as text. Store subscribers, including the collaboration port, always read in the default mode.
reason: The default mode is unchanged, so paragraph text and the shared document format stay the same. A store edit in the editable mode changes ordinary result runs; the two-peer test shows a default-mode peer converging on it. The editor does not offer the editable mode in a collaboration session; that refusal ships with the editor change (issue #1197).
